items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Lee Wiley. Singer. I knew Bunny real good. Made records with Bunny.

ctx.x: He was another guy who drank himself to death.
Lee Wiley. Singer. I knew Bunny real good. Made records with Bunny. Drank hisself to death, just drinking. Too bad.
Bunny was, from what I've read, just a very nice easy going guy.
